# שָׁרְט

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════╗
║                                      ║
║    ش ر ط    ═══    ש ר ט            ║
║                                      ║
║    condition / cut / line            ║
║                                      ║
║    ───────────────────────           ║
║                                      ║
║    the incision that binds           ║
║    the mark that makes covenant      ║
║    the scratch upon flesh            ║
║    that speaks law                   ║
║                                      ║
║    ┌─────────────────────┐           ║
║    │  شرط : stipulation  │           ║
║    │  שרט : to scratch   │           ║
║    │                     │           ║
║    │  same root          │           ║
║    │  same wound         │           ║
║    │  same meaning:      │           ║
║    │                     │           ║
║    │  to cut is to agree │           ║
║    └─────────────────────┘           ║
║                                      ║
║    כרת ברית                          ║
║    to cut a covenant                 ║
║                                      ║
║    every contract                    ║
║    is a scar                         ║
║                                      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════╝
```
